comment: ILLEGAL on concyclicity alone: every one of the six distances is integral (5,6,6,9,9,9) and no three points are collinear, but the two points at t=0 and the two at t=4 form an isosceles trapezoid in the true plane, and parallel chords with equal legs force one circle. This is the obstruction the eight-point problem keeps hitting, reproduced from three lines of arithmetic at characteristic 2.
